name: OAuthFlowSession
description: Plan-32 C — short-lived row that holds OAuth Authorization-Code-flow state from /authorize through /consent. Keyed by the OAuth `state` parameter the client provided. Stores PKCE challenge + redirect_uri so /token can validate them later. tenantId is filled in after the workspace picker; idOfUser is filled in after login. Auto-expires after 5 minutes via the expiresAt column (query-time filter). Lives in schema0 only (platformOnly).

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: OAuth `state` parameter from the client — used as the session lookup key. Opaque from the server's perspective; treated as case-sensitive.

attributes.name: redirectUri
attributes.description: Where /consent redirects back to. Must match the redirect_uri sent to /token (exact-match validation prevents token leakage to attacker-controlled URIs).

attributes.name: codeChallenge
attributes.description: PKCE code_challenge (RFC 7636). Validated against code_verifier at /token.

attributes.name: codeChallengeMethod
attributes.description: PKCE method — usually `S256`. `plain` accepted but discouraged.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Requested OAuth scopes. v1: single `mcp` scope.

attributes.name: userTenantId
attributes.description: Tenant the user selected at the workspace picker. Null until step 3 of the flow (POST /oauth/select-tenant). Named userTenantId — not tenantId — to avoid collision with the platform's implicit multi-tenancy column.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: User who authenticated. Null until step 5 (after login).

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms. /authorize sets this to now + 5 minutes. All reads include `expiresAt > now()` so expired rows are invisible without an explicit cleanup pass.
